verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs say teams can work with their auditor in-platform, and they reference audit submission and audit-partner selection. That supports the core idea of the auditor collaborating inside the product rather than over email. However, nothing documents a dedicated, permission-scoped auditor view of controls and evidence, and the support rests on a single marketing-level line. Missing for 10: documented auditor role/scoped access permissions, auditor-facing view of controls and evidence, an auditor commenting/request workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my auditor works directly in the platform — a scoped auditor view of controls and evidence replaces email threads of PDFs

citations.quote: Collaborative tooling: Assign tasks, set deadlines, and work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform.
Use Sprinto AI to automatically validate your uploaded evidence for relevance, scope, and timeliness before audit submission.
